description: This file defines the MarketplaceDeploymentClient class, which extends AwsClient, and is used to interact with the AWS Marketplace Deployment Service API. It includes method annotations indicating available operations such as listing, tagging, and untagging resources.

classes.name: MarketplaceDeploymentClient
classes.description: A client class for interacting with AWS Marketplace Deployment Service, extending AwsClient.

methods.name: listTagsForResource
methods.description: Retrieves tags for a specified resource.

methods.name: listTagsForResourceAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves tags for a specified resource.

methods.name: putDeploymentParameterAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously adds or updates deployment parameters.

methods.name: tagResource
methods.description: Tags a resource with specified tags.

methods.name: untagResourceAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously removes tags from a resource.
